text:
Eli G: Quick sync: finalizing compact capacity card before dev. Topics: stepper increments (1 vs 0.25), localization of units, SLO guardrail placement, a11y colors.
Noor V: For GPUs we should default to integer steps. But for fractional GPU scheduling (vCPU-like) some pools show 0.5. Make stepper configurable per pool.
Sam T: Agree. UX: show a small suffix "GPUs" next to the stepper and don't expose fractional quanta in tooltips.
Jae P: A11y: when the SLO guardrail toggles on/off announce via aria-live: "SLO guardrail enabled"/"disabled". Also ensure the guardrail hint never covers the cost row on widths <640px.
Noor V: Color: guardrail accent currently uses orange #FF9F43 with 3.8:1 contrast on white; bump to darker orange or add a 1px stroke so text contrast meets 4.5:1.
Eli G: Localization: some locales use comma as decimal separator. Ensure inputs accept localized decimals but store normalized. Frontend library handles that?
Sam T: Dev note: use Intl.NumberFormat for parsing/display; send normalized float to API. Also enforce integer step when pool property `allow_fractional` is false.
Jae P: Keyboard: steppers should increment with arrow keys and PageUp/PageDown for larger jumps. Shift+arrow for 10x increment? maybe too surprising. Keep page keys for +10.
Noor V: Copy tweaks: Cost preview label: change from "Estimated cost / hr" to "Est. cost per hour" (shorter). Guardrail helper: "Limits autoscale to meet SLOs; may increase cost".
Eli G: Microcopy for screen readers: hidden text when pool is preemptible: "Note: pool is preemptible; capacity may be reclaimed". Use visually hidden span.
Sam T: Final dev checklist strings: "integer or fractional step per pool", "Intl.NumberFormat for localized decimals", "aria-live for guardrail state", "tooltip anchored below slider on narrow widths", "contrast >=4.5:1 for guardrail text"
DesignBot: Auto-reminder: run a11y snapshot after changes: https://go/redwood/a11y-checklist
